changes.before: Replace 7 with "7". What type name prints?
changes.after: A type is the kind of value you have, such as a whole number or text.

before: PHP values can be integers, floating-point numbers, strings, booleans, null and other types. A normal variable name can later hold a value of another type.

get_debug_type($value) returns a readable type name. This function call receives a value and returns text describing its type. Commas in echo send the listed pieces to output in order; the second piece here is a newline.
7 is an integer; "7" is a string containing a digit. A value looking numeric does not make its stored type an integer.
Expected output or behavior: int. Compiler evidence is recorded separately from app reading completion.
Optional local transfer task: Store two different kinds of values in turn and inspect their types. You may trace it without a PHP interpreter; reading completion is not proof of a local run.
